# jamfplatform_security_cloud_dns_zone (List Resource)

Lists every Jamf Security Cloud custom DNS zone on the tenant. Jamf Security Cloud exposes no filter parameters for zones, so this list resource takes no filter configuration.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account. `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Secure enterprise access | Zero-Trust Network Access (ZTNA) | Read | `ztna` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lists every custom DNS zone on the tenant. Jamf Security Cloud exposes no
# filter parameters for zones, so this list resource takes no configuration.
list "jamfplatform_security_cloud_dns_zone" "all" {
  provider         = jamfplatform
  include_resource = true

  config {}
}
```
